{{Quote|Tell Captain Kagi to prepare my shuttle for immediate takeoff.|Emperor Palpatine to Mas Amedda|<ref name="ROTS" />|audio=CaptainKagi-RotS.flac}}
'''Kagi''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] in the service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], holding the rank of [[Clone Captain/Legends|captain]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], following the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Kagi was tasked with preparing [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Theta-class T-2c shuttle/Legends|''Theta''-class T-2c shuttle]] for departure to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], where the Emperor recovered his injured [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Kagi's service to Palpatine continued into the Galactic Empire where he served as the Emperor's personal [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].

==Biography==
Created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]],<ref name="db" /> Kagi was the name adopted by a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Clone Captain/Legends|captain]]<ref name="Obsessed" /> serving the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="ROTS" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|II|192|Kagi, Captain}}</ref> against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="ROTS" /> as [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] personal [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Palpatine formally dissolved the Republic, [[Declaration of a New Order|replacing]] it with a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] with himself as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. Palpatine, who was secretly the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious, attempted to [[Order 66/Legends|wipe out]] the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], now Sidious' apprentice Darth Vader. In response, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] set out to confront the two [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]&mdash;Yoda [[Skirmish in the Senate|battling]] Palpatine in the [[Grand Convocation Chamber|Senate rotunda]], and Kenobi [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|fighting]] Darth Vader on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. Once Palpatine forced Yoda to flee, he [[Force sense/Legends|felt]] that Vader was in danger, and in response told his assistant [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] to inform Kagi to prepare his [[Theta-class T-2c shuttle/Legends|''Theta''-class T-2c shuttle]] for immediate departure for Mustafar.<ref name="ROTS" /> After the war, Kagi's service as a Captain continued under the Galactic Empire where<ref name="FFGXW2">{{FFGXW2|set=Galactic Empire Conversion Kit|cardname=Captain Kagi}}</ref> he<ref name="SS&SU" /> served as the Emperor's shuttle pilot. During this time, he piloted a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]].<ref name="FFGXW2" />

==Personality and traits==
Developed from the [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Kagi was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] who stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="db" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:PalpatineShuttlePilot.png|thumb|right|250px|The clone seen piloting Palpatine's personal shuttle.]]
Captain Kagi was first mentioned in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> The only reference to the captain was a single line of dialogue spoken by Palpatine prior to his departure for Mustafar.<ref name="ROTS" /> On [[July]] [[2008]], the trivia book ''[[Obsessed With Star Wars]]'' was released<ref name="Amazon-Hardcover">{{Chronicle|url=titles/obsessed-with-star-wars.html|text=Obsessed With Star Wars|nolive=1}}</ref> and provided new information about Kagi. Question 944 of the trivia book asks which clone captain did Emperor Palpatine ask to prepare his shuttle after his duel with Yoda and gives the possible answers of A. Captain Kogge, B. Captain Kagi, C. Captain Cargo, and D. Captain Clog. With answer B. Captain Kagi being the correct answer, it revealed that Kagi was a clone trooper and not an ordinary crewman.<ref name="Obsessed" /> The release of ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' on [[December 9]], 2008<ref name="Penguin">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/160596/the-complete-star-wars-encyclopedia-by-stephen-j-sansweet-pablo-hidalgo-bob-vitas-daniel-wallace/9780345477637|text=The Complete Star Wars® Encyclopedia}}</ref> further revealed that Kagi was Palpatine's personal pilot during the Clone Wars.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Released on [[April 2]], 2005,<ref name="Planning">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/release/publishing/news20041124.html|text=Planning Your Episode III Bookshelf}}</ref> the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]'' depicts a clone piloting what is identified as Palpatine's secure, personal ''Theta''-class T-2c shuttle, though the identity of this pilot has not been established.<ref name="Cross-Sections">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>
